context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan multiple new outlets.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; vocabulary (手続/財産/複数/売上/設け) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 複数の地域に、店を設けたい。
lines.en: I want to open stores in multiple regions.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 開店の手続は、進んでいますか?
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 手続は、順調に進んでいる。
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 会社の財産は、十分ですか?
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 財産を慎重に使い、複数を設ける。
lines.en: We'll use assets carefully and open several.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 売上の見込みは、明るいですか?
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 複数の店で、売上が増えるはずだ。
lines.en: With several stores, sales should grow.
lines.style: confident boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手続を、確実に進めます。
lines.en: I'll carry out the procedures reliably.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
